source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 737 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 737 was established by Ordinance No. 26193 passed by the Dallas City Council on December 14, 2005. (Ord. 26193)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 737 is established on property located on the west line of Midway Road, north of Royal Lane. The size of PD 737 is approximately 2.1 acres. (Ord. 26193)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 26193)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a child-care facility, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 737A). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A- 4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 26193)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Child-care facility.

(b) Except for a child-care facility, the only main uses permitted in this district are those main uses permitted in the R-16(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-16(A) Single Family District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the R- 16(A) Single Family District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R-16(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this district; etc. (Ord. 26193)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) In this district, the following accessory uses are not permitted:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator.

(c) In this district, the following accessory use is permitted by SUP only:

-- Accessory community center (private). (Ord. 26193)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the R-16(A) Single Family District apply in this district.

(b) For a child-care facility, the following regulations apply:

(1) Front yard. Minimum front yard is as shown on the development plan.

(2) Side and rear yard. Minimum side and rear yard is as shown on the development plan.

(3) Floor area. Maximum floor area is 22,500 square feet.

(4) Height. Maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(5) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 40 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(6) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(7) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is one. (Ord. 26193)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) For a child-care facility, off-street parking must be provided as required by the Dallas Development Code, with not less than 50 spaces being provided in the location shown on the development plan. (Ord. 26193)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 26193)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.110. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) For a child-care facility, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X except that a landscape buffer along the southern property line is not required, and street trees must be provided along the Property fronting on Midway Road 20 feet apart on center, with each street tree being a minimum of four caliper inches in size at the time of planting.

(c) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 26193)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.111. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. Illuminated signs are not permitted in this district. (Ord. 26193)

sections.title: Fences
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.112. FENCES.

For a child-care facility, an eight-foot-high brick and masonry wall must be provided along the western Property line and an eight-foot-high masonry wall or wood or metal fence must be provided to the north and east of the main building in the locations shown on the development plan. (Ord. 26193)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) For a child-care facility, maximum enrollment is 150.

(b) The child-care facility may only operate between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday.

(c) The outdoor play areas for the child-care facility, in the location shown on the development plan, may only operate between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday.

(d) For a child-care facility, light standards may not exceed 10 feet in height, must be directed downward, and are limited to shielded and hooded light fixtures.

(e) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(f) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 26193)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, in this district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 26193)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-737.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 737 is located on Zoning Map No. E-6. (Ord. 26193)
